summary: Iteration 15: tested the welcome page ('wizytówka'), the platform site settings (phone/email/logo), the site and client manifest icon fallback, the per-client QR poster, and regression. Backend: new pytest file test_iteration15_site_welcome.py, 18/18 pass. Covered: GET /public/site shape; PUT /site, POST /site/logo and DELETE /site/logo return 401 unauthenticated, 403 for a client admin and 403 with a foreign Origin; phone/email save is trimmed and persisted, then cleared; invalid phone 'abc', invalid email, 'a;b' multi-email and phone >40 chars all return 422; upload, then the original is <=256px and size=32/180/192/512 return square PNGs; /public/manifest uses the site logo icons; a client without its own logo (temporary slug on Marco Polo) falls back to site logo icons; the Kowalski manifest keeps its own logo; a non-image returns 422 and >1MB returns 413; delete gives logo_version null, logo 404 and manifest back to /icon-192.png; alarm-settings returns email_configured and sms_configured false. Regression: test_multitenant.py and test_iteration14 also pass (52/52 total). Frontend at 390x844, all requested flows pass: (1) a guest with cleared localStorage sees welcome-page-container with logo, title 'MARCO POLO WENTYLACJA', login button and PL/EN switch (EN shows 'SIGN IN'); the contact block is hidden when empty; Zaloguj opens login-form, and login-back returns to the welcome page. (2) /?klient=kowalski goes straight to the login with the Kowalski logo, title and amber theme; there is no welcome page and no back button, and the slug persists for later visits to /. (3) SiteCard: phone 'abc' gives the toast 'Nieprawidłowy e-mail lub numer telefonu' and nothing is saved; a valid phone/email saves ('Zapisano') and then appears on the welcome page (tel:+48600100200, mailto:); the logo upload updates site-logo-preview, shows site-logo-remove and switches the favicon/manifest head links; app-logo uses the site logo for the Marco Polo device (no client logo) and the Kowalski logo for the Kowalski device; the login and welcome pages use the site logo; removing it restores /icon-192.png. (4) QR: client-brand then brand-qr-<KowalskiId> opens qr-dialog; qr-image is a PNG data URL; qr-download has download=qr-kowalski.png and the downloaded file name matches; the poster shows the Kowalski logo, QR, name and link; the QR was decoded with OpenCV to https://fatek-mqtt.preview.emergentagent.com/?klient=kowalski. State is restored: site logo deleted, phone/email empty, Kowalski unchanged, temporary slug removed.

minor.issue: Old logo files are never removed from LOGO_DIR. Each upload writes a new uuid.png and delete only $unsets the DB fields, so orphan files pile up on disk. Delete the previous logo_path file on replace and on delete.

ui_bugs.issue: After the superadmin removes the site logo, the <link rel=icon>, apple-touch-icon and manifest head links still point at /api/public/site/logo?size=32&v=<old> (now 404) until a full reload. Cause: load() returns early when !data.logo_version and never resets the links to /favicon, /icon-192.png and the default manifest.

issues: The welcome page inherits the last-used theme from localStorage. After a superadmin with the blue theme logs out, the guest welcome page is blue instead of the brand green. Consider forcing the default/site theme on the welcome page for guests.
The header label next to the logo reads 'FATEK · MQTT', a technical controller/protocol name, on a customer-facing business card. Consider 'Marco Polo' or dropping it.
brand-logo-preview-<id> for a client without its own logo falls back to /icon-192.png, but the app, QR and manifest actually fall back to the site logo. Use siteLogoUrl(site) for consistency.

action_items: LOW: in useSite, when logo_version is null and no brand_slug is set, reset the head links (icon, apple-touch-icon, manifest) to the defaults.
LOW: delete the old logo file from LOGO_DIR on replace and on delete, for both the site and client logos.
Optional design: use a fixed default theme on the guest welcome page; reconsider the 'FATEK · MQTT' label; make the BrandEditor logo-preview fallback use the site logo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py site_settings uses _id 'main' (a string), which is fine. /public/site never leaks _id.

QrDialog: the poster uses a 'Barlow Condensed' canvas font. If the webfont has not loaded when the dialog first opens, the name falls back to sans-serif. Consider await document.fonts.ready before drawing.
QrDialog renders the data URL only after async drawing, and until then the qr-download <a> has no href; clicking it early does nothing. Acceptable, but consider disabling it until ready.
The review request mentioned the slug 'fatek-mqtt', but no client has that slug (404). The fallback was verified with a temporary slug on Marco Polo instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 low-priority bug, minor design notes
